headline: Euro hits new all-time high. What it means for loans, holidays and store prices
summary: On September 23 the euro reached a new all-time high against the Romanian leu. The article says the development affects loans, holiday costs and store prices.
why: The euro-leu rate affects the cost of euro-denominated loans and imports for Romanian households and businesses. Currency moves also shape inflation and the central bank's policy room.
